subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@pulsemed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes during morning ingest and scheduled batch jobs (affects user experience).
- Regulatory requirement to isolate PHI workloads (VPC + customer KMS/HSM).
- High variability in monthly inference cost; need predictable unit economics for budgeting.

Goals we heard:
- Dedicated capacity with predictable throughput for 24/7 inference of up to ~40k tokens/min at peak.
- SOC 2 evidence and audit logs for data access and model inference.
- 99.9% uptime SLA and p95 token latency target ~150ms for 512-token requests.

Recommended Redwood Dedicated configuration (initial proposal):
- Reserved pool: 4 x 80GB GPUs (NVIDIA A100 class) to start, autoscale up to 8 nodes for burst (policy-based).
- Network isolation: Private VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for key control.
- Deployment plan: 2-week kick-off -> 2-week PoC (throughput and latency targets) -> production cutover.
- Observability: Per-route latency & cost dashboards, prefix KV caching to reduce token spend.

Open items / asks for PulseMed:
1) Decision-makers to involve: CTO (Tom Wilson) + procurement (Sofia Martinez) — you mentioned both on the call.
2) Security questionnaire: please send the vendor questionnaire you referenced; we’ll populate and return within 3 business days.
3) Test dataset access: a subset of redacted requests (and expected QPS) to validate caching/latency during PoC.

Attachments: capacity-plan.xlsx (deployment sizing), redwood-dedicated-sow-draft.pdf (SOW template).

Proposed next steps:
- Tech deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer (Dev) — 60 minutes to review architecture and PoC criteria.
- We’ll produce a preliminary cost estimate and updated SOW for your procurement team.

Can you confirm a good time for the technical deep-dive? I’m available Wed 9/16 or Thu 9/17 morning PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0191
